title: Sissik Taaqeh Baahe
intro: caylale miraacah cokmih buxal, takkem duude wayta essero xayyowteh sugteeh, mango mari ken melleb yasmitoonuh qalalak sugen. Usuk, taama dubuh aracat gactam duddam inki numih angaaraw diini ixxiga luk inkih tan physical prowess, unveling moment too echo uddur.
clues: Anu kaxxa amoyti ayfaafal sugeeh, usug kaadu nabiyyih sugeeh, kaxxaam elle yaamineh yan maroh fanat sooleh an.
Anu girah ginok masugiyyo hinnay kaxxa dagar maqar le ginok masugiyyo, takkay immay anu tukteenay kaxxam caylale.
Amoyti xer baaxok qarkayto baahaanam essere way, abam faxximtam nagay eexegeh.
Anu kitaabak liyo ixxigat yaabeeh, faxe num gacsa abaamak naharal, qarkayto amoytak foocal daffeyte.
Yok abto inni caylak masuginnaay, nummale ixxiga Yallak dubuk tamaatem mayballaak sugte.
Anu Suura An-Naml elle tan innal, Sheba Amoytih kursi inki intih uddur baahe numu.

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
